reviews.text: I was desperate to find a vet who could do an emergency Pyrometra surgery. I was referred to Marina Veterinary Center by a friend. I called them and Juana was extremely helpful and kind. They were able to get my baby in quickly. I was very nervous as my dog also has a heart murmur. Dr Halligan was amazing!! She had just done a dental surgery on a 14 year old dog with a heart murmur. She reassured me that all would be fine. She called me before the surgery and after. I am so grateful for Dr Halligan and Juana at the front desk and the entire team at Marina Veterinary Center. My dog is doing really well.
They do amazing work
Had an exam, seemed very short. Not sure if that was because we had a coupon for a  free exam.

The team helped us with our cat’s emergency when we walked in without an appointment. They referred us to an amazing eye clinic and also helped us with the insurance paperwork. We really appreciate everything they did for us. Thank you so much!

I took my shepherd and one of our cats in to be seen. Both got checked from one end to the other. Murphy was his usual "I don't want to be here" but was compliant, a little hard getting him away from me.
I feel Dr Halligan checked both of them thoroughly. It's nice having the same vet seeing them. The quality of care just becomes so much better!

Dr. Halligan and the various doctors at this clinic have all been very caring and honest. I have taken my two dogs for over 10 years now. They helped us diagnose our dog with cancer and referred us to specialist. They are always good at sharing information to emergency pet hospitals. My other dog was diagnosed with addisons disease and they have helped us do monthly vaccines and blood work at a lower costs. The staff are very good about reminding you when you are due for a physical or vaccines over all very good doctors everyone is kind and they all love animals.
I have a St. Bernard poodle mix 9 years old.

Amazing experience every time!
Professional, warm and friendly staff and always feel safe knowing my beloved animal is receiving the uttermost care.
The Dr and assistant were both very professional and helpful

I scheduled an appointment for a Heath Certificate for my dog since we are traveling domestically. The service was great! Very professional and knowledgeable about the process including the airport. Thank you!
They are always kind, quick and patient with me and my pets!
Thorough and professional
Dr Halligan is a genius. She is the only vet to have accurately diagnoses olives issues with allergies that she has had for almost 4 years and multiple vets. I highly recommend this veterinarian.

Amazing Service from the entire team as soon as we checked in! The front desk staff was very kind and accommodating to my last minute (same day) request for my furbaby. She kept me on the waitlist and called me as soon as a cancellation came up. I was able to take in my boy on the same day and had a great experience with the doctor!

I have been going to Marina Veterinary Center  for maybe 1 -2 years and I have never been happier!  I have recently taken in my two dogs for various concerns and feel like the doctors that I saw were truly concerned about them.  They told me what course of action they wanted to take and why!  The doctors, the technicians, and the front desk people are kind and considerate!  I highly recommend Marina Veterinary Center!  They are the best!!

We have been using them for many years.  Dr Karen Halligan is very caring and knowledgeable.  She is taking great care of our dogs.  The staff is very helpful and I highly recommend Marina Veterinary.

I ♥️ EVERYTHING about this place! The service is stellar, and the employees have always been cordial and professional.
More expensive than some, but worth it!

After 5yrs of "care" and a few thousand dollars over last 90days for near death experience with my cat, these vets are nice but there's no consistency. I saw or spoke to a new person almost every week. Some techs there are super nice (male) some are super nasty. The real tell is if I return calls or email or stop in for food/meds no one ever asks how she's doing. Awful front desk.

Thank you for your feedback.
 We understand that cost can be a concern, and we strive to provide high-quality, thorough care that reflects time, expertise and resources involved.
If you ever have questions about pricing or options, we're always happy to discuss them with you.
Always ready to help me carrying my cat inside the office and back to my car. The staff is very professional.

I was dreading the trip to the vet. My two tabbies are house cats and are terrified of car rides and that's why I switched Marina Veterinary Center it just a few minutes away, and the staff is very kind and gentle with my two girls.
Thank you very much Dr. Holligan for kind care of my girls!

Not only is Marina Vet good at communicating reminders but also in person…
Thanks for caring for Ladybug!!

I had a wonderful experience at this clinic and we will most likely be switching our primary vet to this center. They were able to treat my cat much more effectively and affordably than the previous place I visited. The doctor and the entire staff were incredibly kind and professional. I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend them to others!
Have been bringing my fur kids here for 8 years. They have always taken such great care of them and treated all of us with respect and kindness.

I can't remember the girls name the receptionist when I called and you know my cat name and I said how do you know she says I'm a psychic that was the funniest thing I've ever heard over the phone I don't know her name is but I love her everybody there was incredibly nice I can't even tell you how nice it is to meet nice people these days cause there ain't many left so thank you thank you thank you period peace out
Everyone is always so friendly and takes such good care of us! Doc Halligan is awesome and so is all the staff!

Dr Halligan is a great vet.  She has looked after my different dogs  for over 20 years. She recently gave me several treatment options for my eleven year old dog from affordable to deep dive. The vet techs and desk staff are kind and well informed.
I feel confident with our vet, Karen Halligan.

Dr Halligen is so kind sơ sweet ans sơ gentle.  Impeccable service!  She was very attentive.  I had an emergency case and she took me in right away and got my old  (baby) back to walking.   I love that she uses Erchonia light laser therapy along side acupuncture and traditional medicine to give my dog a thorough and well balanced care.   I can’t thank her enough.  She continues to check in on how my dog is doing personally sơ I appreciate it.   She is someone who is authentic and straightforward with kindness.   Her stag are wonderful as well.
I just love that everyone there cares about my boy - Sherman!
Kitty got shots in and out fast. Friendly. Tech
I am new to dog ownership and I am very lucky to use Marina Vet Center to help guide me in with my dog's care. Plus the staff is friendly and very helpful!!
Addressed concerns at my dogs annual exam and we’re very sweet to him!

Dr. Jordan is wonderful! Both as a diagnostician and in her bedside manners. Please don't lose her.
Bill Westling fbo Bodie & Barry.
Thanks.
My cat was promptly examined and I was given an estimate for treatment. I only wish that it could be discounted.
Smauggie and I had such a good experience. We went home singing.
Very friendly crew members for explaining thoroughly about the what pets into and what is necessary for their health. I feel relieved and safe about my pets.
Thank you for the high rating, The team appreciates you and your furry friend : )

I am a US ARMY VETERAN & DO NOT COME HERE TO WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY.
I drove here today in the traffic to what I thought was the best veterinary clinic even though they are OVER PRICED due to his awesome doctor and the staff. However, the technician who handled my dog's vaccine was DISRESPECTFUL, ARROGANT and UNGRATEFUL to  a returning customer.   She refused to give back his muzzle he came in with and the dr.. from this clinic have previously given him from past appointments because I asked it if I could have it.. His doctor gave it to me without charging me the cost.. I was very grateful.   Today, this technician after I told her that it was given to me.  She kept on going and even asked me , if I paid for it acting like she owns the clinic or that she bought the supplies there ..  I have paid so much money to this clinic for my dog and cat for anyone to be treating me like I am lying or I stole something when my dog entered that clinic today wearing his muzzle.. This shows how UNGRATEFUL, ARROGANT & UNPROFESSIONAL this place is to a returning customer.  This place is so expensive to be treating anyone with so much ARROGANCE AND DISRESPECT causing me panic attack!

DONT COME HERE.. THEY WILL ONLY MAKE YOU FEEL BAD after just paying at the counter.

This clinic caused me panic attack with that technician hassling me making hard for me to get his muzzle he came in here with !  I didnt come there to be treated with so much ARROGANCE and POWER TRIP,  but to get my dog's vaccine..

YOU DO NOT MISTREAT A CUSTOMER AFTER SHE JUST PAID!

I am a USARMY DISABLED VETERAN with an ESA DOG who got disrespect at this ARROGANT, UNGRATEFUL , DISRESPECTFUL PLACE .  I came here without a panic attack and left with one enough to notify my mental health VA west los angeles Hospital for the panic I attack I am going through... Chest pain and fast heart beat!

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY TO THIS ALREADY OOVER PRICED, UNGRATEFUL, DISRESPECTFUL & ARROGANT PLACE!
So compassionate and helpful!

Dr. Halligan is a very knowledgeable, compassionate, and caring vet. She has experience with both traditional western veterinary medicine and is also educated and open to alternative treatment modalities. She has been very attentive and real world with her approach in treating my senior dog who is fighting cancer.
I appreciate how fair and how empathetic and skilled she is.

Doc and team are amazing!!! They took such an emotional time for us during the passing of our sweet Lilly and made my husband and I feel so loved, Doc even read a prayer. We will forever be grateful for the kindness of everyone who works there!

Absolutely disgusted ! This morning my dog had a seizure for the first time, I call Marina Veterinary  in a panic and they said to come for 9am. I am no longer living in close proximity to their location and had my baby with me and was told over the phone that now I would be occurring a ‘Late fee’ the front desk passed me to someone else and the first words again we’re  ‘So there’s going to be a late fee  it’s after 9’ not ‘How is your pet?’ Zero concern for animal welfare and all about $$$ - I will never go back again. If you have a pet emergency go to VEG in Manhattan beach, they were wonderful and told me they would see me as soon as I arrived, No late fee, No attitude.

TL;DR ~ Marina Vet is the wonderful, attentive care all animals deserve.
Taking Charlie to Marina Vet saved his life. He was misdiagnosed with arthritis a year ago, when his front right arm started twitching, his back right foot got swollen, and he started experiencing lameness, switching between his front and back feet. He was on anti-inflammatory meds since then.

His condition worsened severely a couple of weeks ago, my once very energetic boy could hardly walk, sitting up or down became painful and hard. Dr. Halligan took time to review all his files and x-rays, to carefully examine him herself, and also referred a specialist outside of Marina Vet, because she said everything she saw didn't look like arthritis to her. It is thanks to her attentiveness and care that Charlie is back to being a happy, active boy.

We discovered he has an autoimmune disease and started the right medication last Sunday. Charlie went from so much pain a week ago, and not walking anymore, to bouncing around on his favorite walk this morning. It feels miraculous. I am so grateful that he's finally feeling better, all thanks to Marina Vet. Words are not enough to express what their care has given us.
Thank you for the 5 star review. We are here for you when needed.
Always good experience

I am so happy my Zoey is receiving excellent treatment for her collapsed trachea condition. The blue light lazer therapy Dr. Halligan suggested has calmed her condition. She is  much happier! I am very grateful for the attentive care the doctor and all the techs are giving my Zoey! Thank you!
Quick, clean, efficient and friendly.

SHOUT OUT TO AMANDA 🥰 FIRST TIME FUR MOM and let me tell you she didn’t hesitate to take me in as walk in not knowing what was wrong with my baby… such a sweet heart and very very helpful with all the information she gave me SHE A MVP - Mr. Lovely my daughter and I want to say THANK YOU 😊

My dog Gerda underwent 2 mast cell tumor removals from Dr Moss. He is an extremely skilled surgeon and did a fantastic job. My dog is feeling great, and I would highly recommend Dr. Moss for any surgical matters as he is very knowledgeable, professional and highly skilled. I was also extremely happy with Dr Gaudier for diagnosing the mast cell tumor and also for noticing that my dog have yeast in the ears. He treated that and now she’s feeling great ..Dr Moss and Dr Gaudier are excellent veterinarians and I will continue to bring my dog to both of these doctors. Thank you again for the great job.
Thank you so much for the 4 star review. Your support means a lot to our team.

We have been going to Marina Veterinary Center for a few years now but this recent appointment was the best appointment we’ve had. It was our first appointment with Dr. Holly Jordan who is now our preferred vet. She was very detailed and thorough, asked tons of questions and spent time to get to know both myself and my pup. Her advice was based on what was best for my dog and what I could afford to do at the time. I really appreciated her thoughtful care and transparency.

We are new to the area in Westchester and needed a good vet when one of our dogs became ill with a terrible cough. A friend recommended Marina Vet Center on Lincoln and they took us right away. The front office was welcoming and the veterinary doctor was thorough and very caring. I couldn't have been more impressed with the entire experience.
Wonderful staff & Doc Halligan awesome
Went and got a shot came out perfect and he didn't complain
Simply the BEST Doc Holly Jordan DVM and Doc hallogan and all staff are so helpful and caring..So safe so attentive andso caring. Lucky to have them.
First time client with a new kitten.  Dr Haligan was great-friendly made sure she got to know us and our pet.  Happy to have them as our new vets
I’ve been going to Marina vet for years and everyone there is wonderful

If you want passionate care, only superseded by a stout, professional  acumen and dialogue, Doctor Jordan and her staff, are nonpareil!
We just adopted a large, aggressive, German Shep that she and the folks at Marina handled with aplomb.  Best place in town, and perhaps…

Finding this Veterinary has been a blessing, I must deeply show my gratitude towards all the professionals, they not only did an excellent job being efficient with their diagnosis and treatment, but they also are very trustworthy and honest people that try their best to meet you and your pets needs, instead of pushing unnecessary things purely for profit.

I definitely recommend them to my own family and friends, compared to many other Vets in the industry, this one stands out greatly.

Evi and I thank you so much!
They care about all breeds,got my anxious pup to allow them to complete an exam.  I was shocked 😲
Lovely Team, outstanding Doctor and great care for my pets and me!!!
Dr. Holly Jordan is special vet doctor. She's kind, knowledgeable and generous with her time. Thanks

Love Juana, and quick check in with short wait. Alex Hernandez very welcoming and I liked that he spoke Spanish to me. Dr Holly Norton knowledgeable, warm, & a great communicator. Lulu(aka Lucy Lu) liked all too.
Got nails clipped cause our puppy is impossible and anal glands evacuated. Very kind and informative. This is our primary vet and will be for our our pets
Wonderful care and they honor the way to help you and your companion. They got me in next day being a new client from Wyoming.
Thank you for the review

I have been taking my dog to Marina Vet Center for the last several years, and I’m really disappointed with the drop in quality from this vet over the last year or so. I feel that something has shifted in administrative management, because where I used to get prompt responses to emails, follow ups from vet visits, or callbacks from doctors, I now have to call and ask the front desk to email me the invoice I requested, or hunt down follow up phone calls with the doctor while my pet is still sick and showing symptoms. I don’t know if there is a staff shortage, or a change in management, but the drop in quality of care is felt. The vet staff is of course caring and good with my pet, but I still needed to voice my frustrations.
Everyone was so friendly and I truly enjoyed my experience here
Staff was friendly and helpful. Dr. Jordan and the Vet tech were attentive to my senior dog who wasn't feeling well.
Been twice this year for emergency care. Dr. Budde and the whole team are very welcoming and thorough!

Great experience for my dog. I switched to this vet years ago as a closer to home option for Sophie, my 16 y/o dog's kidney disease treatments and really appreciated their level of service. I've been to a VCA hospital where you feel like your pet is in a factory line, in and out as quickly as possible. This vet provides higher attention to detail and all the staff are very friendly!

Then after my boxer bulldog passed away last year, they were the sweetest. Sent me a card and flowers. Now I've returned to them with my latest rescue dog, Simba. :)
Dr. Jordan is the best!
Nice staff and doctor
As always, office and professional staff were compassionate and courteous. That really care  about our pets.

Dr. Jordan and everyone there was absolutely spectacular and welcoming. I have a very skittish dog and they went out of their way to be so kind and gentle. I want to check on the name of the woman at the front desk because she was extra extraordinary as well. Thank you so much, POPPY
Always receive excellent care from Marina Veterinary Center team.
Amazing place. They always show love to my ragdolls. 10/10 service

Dr. Halligan and her team are AMAZING!! She takes such great care for of our sweet maltipoo, Samantha. We are very grateful for her entire staff! This is such a wonderful place to bring your pets. Highly recommend!
The office was able to get me a same-day appointment for heartworm test. I did not wait very long in the reception room. Everything went smoothly and my dog left happy.
Always a wonderful experience!

Incredible team! Dr. Halligan is amazing and helped my dog after he had a been attacked by another dog. She and her team stayed late to help me and my pup with the best care possible. She put her magic hands to work and he is on the mend! A true blessing she and her team are! The establishment is always really well taken care of and everybody is eager to help.
A wonderful place I highly recommend it.

The staff and Dr. Halligan @ Marina Vet Center were amazing. My dog had 2 cracked molars, one with an abscess - and they were able to get her in right away to remove the tooth...and save the other one.
Also, lesson learned....no more himalayan yak chews for my girl!!! Ruby cracked both of her teeth because of them.

The staff and the doctors are extremely friendly and caring about the well being of all animals.  Went in 2 years ago regarding my beloved cat of 20 years who was dying. They were extremely compassionate.

Grateful for the help with Charlie's nail.  He would not let me near it.  The staff quickly figured out the situation, fixed it and gave him pain meds.  At least it was not a broken toe.  He's running on all fours again.

MVC is one of the best experiences I've had with vet care. The front desk staff is friendly, their scheduling almost always runs on time and if they fall behind they are communicative about it. They are knowledgable in their assessment and work to get you in and out, without ever feeling rushed.
They took excellent care of my sick dog on short notice. They were a god send and had him back to his normal self in no time.
I've been patronizing this facility for 5 years. The wait time on this visit was longer than usual, but the service was pleasant and professional. Highly recommend!

The team at Marina Veterinary Center is always so supportive and helpful when we come in. The front desk staff are kind and welcoming, even when they are extremely busy. The vet techs are sensitive to our dog’s anxiety and always give him extra love and care, especially during his least favorite activity - nail trims. We are deeply grateful for Dr. Jordan - she spends time with our big guy and always makes him feel comfortable (and his parents too!) before any exams and procedures. Her dedication shines through and we are so lucky to have found her. Thank you all for all that you do!
Dr. Jordon was kind and good with my senior dog.

Took my FIP cat for a visit today as I was stressed about him not eating enough. Was seen by an older female doctor (didn't get her name) who kept having the tech relay messages and didn't just come in to the room for half an hr. The first thing she said to me when she walked in was "look, most cats don't survive this disease" and started boasting about her 30+ years of experience and how deadly this disease is. She then pushed some probiotic that no one's even heard of on me. Maybe it's time to go back to school and educate yourself on the newest medications. FIP is not a death sentence anymore and I highly recommend your vets to follow this FB group. Not going back.
Dr. Jordan and the entire staff at Marina Veterinary are so kind and caring. My kitties just love them there and I know they are receiving the care they need.

My Sasha’s dirt visit to Marina Veterinary Center.  Dr Halligan performed a spay procedure on my Sasha.  Dr Halligan was very reassuring and informative.   The procedure went well and Sasha is doing well.  Everything is going as Dr Halligan said it would.  I was also impressed with the office staffs courtesy and efficiency.  This is a well run facility and I will be returning.
Super easy to make an appointment for my dog -knowledgeable and friendly staff!

Exceptional experience from the minute My dog and I entered.  They have treats on the counter for the animals!! The staff is attentive and helpful.  Dr. Halligan is the best!! She always takes her time.  I never feel rushed and she truly cares for your animal. She is very knowledgeable and the array of services she's skilled in is exceptional!!  Highly recommend!
The front desk personnel are very professional and cheerful! Dr. Jordan is calm and caring and the technicians are as well.

Lilly and Prince love going to the vet. The staff are very kind and friendly and our dogs definitely are aware of this! Thank you for taking such great care our pets. We have been referring all our friends and clients and they are also happy with your care and services!

Wonderful experience, great staff. The front desk people were all friendly and helpful, especially Amanda. The vet Assisistant, Jayson, was upper helpful, explained everything, and calmed my nervous pet right away. Dr F was also great.
I love Ty & Claudia ❤️❤️❤️

We had an urgent situation with our cat who needed to be checked for a contagious virus and vaccinated. After visiting two other nearby veterinary clinics that couldn't help us, we contacted Marina Veterinary Center, and we're so glad we did.

From the moment we reached out, their team was caring, friendly, and understanding of the urgency. They let us know they could see us the same day (June 28, 2025), which was a huge relief.

Melissa at the front desk was especially helpful, guiding us through the paperwork and clearly explaining the pricing upfront—which we found to be very fair. Even though they were busy, we were seen quickly and never felt rushed.

We also want to give a special thanks to Jayson, the vet assistant. He was compassionate, attentive, and shared that he has four cats of his own, which made us feel even more understood during a stressful time. Not only did they check our cat for the virus and administer the vaccine, but they also treated a skin condition, clipped her nails, checked her teeth, and gave her a general examination—all without us even needing to ask.

The veterinarian who saw our cat was very knowledgeable, kind, and took the time to explain the test results (thankfully negative, though a follow-up test is needed later). We also deeply appreciated their empathy regarding our other cat, who was critically ill in the emergency room at the time.

Marina Veterinary Center provided excellent care and compassion when we needed it most. We’re incredibly grateful and will absolutely be returning here for our cat’s future care.
Helpful staff n clean office

Definitely recommend this vet. We recently moved in the location and Marina Vet is the one closest to us and it’s very convenient. Staff is friendly and I recommend asking them questions to be more informed especially when you have concerns with your pet.

This place is awesome! Called in to make an appointment and Melissa was super nice and helped me out with all my questions. Just took my Bobby who is an older dog and they were all attentive. Claudia was so attentive and helped us out from when we got there and there throughout the entire exam. Definitely recommend this vet clinic! Glad i changed my vet and came here! Simply amazing!
Such a caring vet! Very happy I found this place and it's so near my house.

I am so severely dissatisfied with this clinic. The only good thing about it is that it’s across the street and prices are not as high as other places. Last Thursday my cat had a urinary blockage and was taking in, they did the procedure and told me that he needs to stay in for 2 days. My cat has attachment anxiety and he is severely stressed if I’m not around. Any explanation of that to the staff - did not make a difference. My cat was locked in that cage from 7pm till 8am next without supervision and food. When I came on Saturday at 8am to feed my cat and just be near him so he is less stressed before they will take the carthrege- guess what - not only they did not allow me to see my cat, neither to feed him. All reasoning that he hadn’t been fed for more than 14 hours were pointless cause this clinic values Bureaucracy over empathy and individual needs of a cat. Saturday front desk lady lacks 100 empathy and I’m surprised that such people works there. Where when I point out that my cat is in distress - they reply “he is fine”. When I said “what if you’ve been locked for 14 hours without food” - the front desk lady lashed out on me saying “how dare you to threaten me” where I never threatened her and was trying to call out to her empathy, imagining how it would feel. But she tried to make me guilty. So I took him back Saturday around 10am and when I brought him back he was severely hungry. But because of sedation that they put - he could not eat food, like his chewing was uncoordinated. So my poor cat only ate maybe at 12pm. Anyway you would think that after that things got better? Ever since that surgery - my cat is in so much pain, urinating. The doctor “seem to follow up” via email with me but she never gave any clear guidance. So communication and setting the expectations of what’s recovery would look like - nothing. Now it’s been a week, and I called them saying that my cat is recovering very slow (I’m suspecting partially because of the stress they caused him by not allowing me to be near him) and one of his meds is out, maybe he needs a refill or something else? My heart’s aches in pain every time he pees, he growls so much. And guess what they reply “oh since you went to emergency yesterday, go see that doctor again. We do t have doctors for the next 24-48 hours”. Like seriously wow. That type of don’t giving a shit about animal made me really really furious. So STAY AWAY from this clinic if your pet needs more than “annual exam”.   Pay more - but get the care that your pet needs. And on the picture below you can see “how my cat is fine”. That the picture the lady from front desk Saturday morning when they were not allowing me to see him.

We always bring our two cats, Sammy and Simon, to Marina Veterinary Center and we love the place. Everyone there is super kind and caring. Last week, my husband and I took the boys in and were so well taken care of by Claudia and the vet (wish I could remember her name!). They made the whole visit easy and warm, and it’s clear they really love what they do. So grateful for them!
Awesome center! My dog is a lot more healthy and happy. Thank you. Spot is living her best life.

The doctors and vet techs here are absolutely wonderful! We switched over from VCA to Marina Vet Center last year and I’m so glad we did. They don’t try to upsell you and are honest with their work. Last year they gave great advice on how my cat can lose some weight and a year later he’s back to a healthy weight. My boy also recently had a dental cleaning here and his teeth look great! They always take great care with him. Highly recommend this vet.

This place is one of the best vets I’ve ever been to. My family and I had to take my dog to unfortunately be put to sleep due to illness and from when we got there, we received the best and most compassionate care. Were greeted by Claudia who was there with us through the entire process and knew how difficult it was. She made us all feel comfortable and was very sympathetic. Our boy followed her with ease which made us feel ease as well.
The dr was also very friendly and thoughtful and assured us that he was no longer going to be in pain. I will be taking my other pup there from now on. Great establishment and staff is awesome.

I’ve brought my two pets here so when I gained a third I knew this was the place to go. My nurse Claudia alongside Dr. Jordan explained everything very thoroughly. They definitely have patience for my scared pup. It’s comforting to know that I can take my pets to a place where they are very loved.
-5 stars for a reason never disappointed when I come in ! Truly appreciated , the care to my two pups that they always receive . Thank you     Claudia and all the team <3

This clinic is such a welcoming and caring place! From the moment I walked in, the staff made me and my fur baby feel at ease. The environment is clean, friendly, and professional. John was incredible! He treated my fur baby with so much compassion and took the time to answer all of my questions without hesitation. I felt completely confident knowing we were in such good hands.

I recently took my senior dog to Marina Veterinary Center when he was having incontinence issues, which turned out to be a UTI. I can't say enough good things about our experience, especially with John, the vet tech who assisted us. John was exceptionally kind and gentle with my elderly dog, showing genuine compassion throughout our visit. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure my dog was comfortable during the examination. The clinic's staff was professional and efficient in diagnosing the UTI, and the treatment plan they provided worked wonderfully. I highly recommend Marina Veterinary Center - and hope you get to work with John!

I’ve been bringing my dog, Ocean, to this veterinary clinic since he was a puppy, and we have received nothing but the best care ♥️ I’m truly grateful for everyone who works here, but I especially want to recognize Claudia Morales. She has such a warm heart and genuinely cares about every pet that walks through the door. She has been with us through thick and thin, always showing the most compassionate bedside manner during even the hardest times.

Ocean loves coming here because he knows he’s loved, and that means the world to me. I’m beyond grateful for this place and the amazing people who make it so special!

The team here is always so helpful and caring. They took such good care of my kiddos and I will always be thankful for that. My cats can sometimes be a little wild but John and Claudia always took their time and managed to always get the job done! Thank you guys for always being able to help me out (:

Dr. Halligan is amazing! She has been our vet with several pups, all of which have had their fair share of challenges and she has been outstanding. We know our fur babies are getting the best care when they see her.

John and the rest of the staff are so warm, friendly and caring. They truly love what they do and it shows. They have always been incredibly kind, helpful and most importantly show our pups so much attention and love when we visit.

We unfortunately had to make the painful decision to put one of our guys down and everyone at Marina Vet handled us and our boy Alfred with such incredible compassion. From the moment we were greeted at the door, we were treated like there was no one but us there for the day. We were able to spend as much time as we needed with our Alfred before, during and after.  We will forever be grateful for that support at such an incredibly difficult time.

The facility is conveniently located, we have never had an issue finding parking and is modern, clean and spacious.

We are truly grateful to have found Marina Veterinary Center, and highly recommend for pet parents that want top notch care for their fur babies!

I am so happy to have found Marina Veterinary Center. They have wonderful staff, are very responsive, and have been very helpful in diagnosing and treating my young, orange tabby when issues have arisen. A few months ago I was struggling to figure out what was going on with my young, healthy guy, and they diagnosed and treated him quick and effectively - I am so grateful.
